title: Introduce signalizer & prefill-advisor: automated prefill + compact quant defaults
author: Priya Kapoor
merge_outcome: Merged after CI red-green and one follow-up hotfix
release_notes: Adds automatic prefill signaler and a prefill-advisor CLI that recommends batching/prefill and compact quantization defaults per workload. Safe-eval gating prevents automatic deployment of aggressive quant profiles. Backwards compatible; opt-in behavior behind config flag 'prefill_advisor.enabled'.
description:
Summary: This PR introduces 'Signalizer', a lightweight traffic-signal synthesizer that produces per-tenant prefill and batching heuristics based on 72-hour rolling telemetry, and a companion 'prefill-advisor' CLI that exposes recommended defaults (batch size, prefill window, compact quant profile) for workloads. Motivation: many customers underutilize prefill and compact quant profiles because choosing safe defaults is hard; manual tuning is slow. The goal is to provide automated, explainable recommendations that reduce token cost while preserving generation quality via gated evals.

What this changes (high level):
- New service: orchestration/signalizer (Rust module) that ingests sampling telemetry and emits scored suggestions.
- Prefill-advisor CLI (Python) that operators can run to preview and export tenant default manifests.
- Compact quant profile presets: compact-small, compact-general, compact-high-curie (quant/activation knobs tuned to common workloads).
- Eval gating: each recommended profile is accompanied by a small regression test harness (prompt-set + eval metric) to detect quality regressions before apply.
- Telemetry: new metrics (signalizer.prefill_score, signalizer.traffic_entropy, prefill_advisor.suggested_quant_level) and trace annotations for reasoning.
- Safety: recommendations are optional and behind feature flag 'prefill_advisor.enabled'; automatic rollouts are disabled by default.

Checklist: 
- [x] Implement core signalizer ingestion pipeline and scoring model
- [x] Add prefill-advisor CLI with preview/export options
- [x] Add compact quant preset files and mapping logic
- [x] Add minimal eval harness (integration tests)
- [x] Add telemetry + dashboard links and docs
- [x] Add unit tests and integration smoke tests
- [x] Include migration notes and CLI help text

Commits (summary):
- 1/7: bootstrapped signalizer service and telemetry protobufs
- 2/7: scoring heuristics: prefill_score, latency_impact_estimator, cost_delta_estimator
- 3/7: compact quant presets and quant-selector policy layer
- 4/7: prefill-advisor CLI (preview/export/apply-disabled-by-default)
- 5/7: eval harness + sample prompt sets for two tenant archetypes
- 6/7: add dashboards and Prometheus metrics + tracing annotations
- 7/7: tests, docs, and CLI polish

Files changed (high level):
- src/orch/signalizer/mod.rs (new): core ingestion, scoring, policy outputs
- src/orch/signalizer/README.md (new): design rationale and metric definitions
- tooling/prefill-advisor/cli.py (new): preview/export CLI and YAML manifest generator
- config/quant_presets/compact-*.yaml (new x3): compact quant presets and metadata
- docs/ops/auto-prefill-and-quant.md (updated): operator guidance and opt-in instructions
- tests/integration/test_signalizer_eval.py (new): regression gating smoke tests
- dashboards/signalizer-overview.json (new): Grafana dashboard for prefill signals

Small illustrative snippet (policy output example):
- Example manifest produced: "\ntenant: acme-corp\nrecommended_defaults:\n  batch_size: 8\n  prefill_window_ms: 120\n  quant_profile: compact-general\n  expected_cost_delta_pct: -18.3\n  regression_risk_score: 0.06\n"

Backward compatibility and rollout notes:
- Signalizer runs as an additional consumer of existing sampling streams; no change required for customers unless they opt into applying recommendations.
- The CLI "prefill-advisor export" produces a tenant defaults manifest that operator can apply via existing tenant-defaults API. By default the CLI makes suggestions only; apply is explicit.
- For hosts using automatic config sync pipelines, an operator must enable 'prefill_advisor.allow_auto_apply' explicitly.

Review conversation (high level):
- Maya Chen: "Can you add a regression harness that runs per-suggested-quant-profile? We need a measurable quality delta before recommending compact-high-curie. Also please add a short-circuit if traffic entropy is below 0.12 so we avoid overfitting to repetitive workloads."
- Priya (author): "Added regression harness and the entropy short-circuit. See tests/integration/test_signalizer_eval.py and scoring logic in src/orch/signalizer/mod.rs lines ~210-260. Also added docs that explain the entropy threshold and how to override per-tenant."
- Liam O'Neill: "CI flaky on integration test in first run. Please stabilize timing-dependent sleep in test harness."
- Priya: "Fixed by switching to condition-wait on metric emission and added retry loops; reran CI."
- Diego Alvarez: "Please ensure the default compact presets are annotated with safe_fallback=true so runtime will fallback to base quant on any decode anomalies."
- Priya: "Added safe_fallback flag to presets and a unit test to cover it."

CI checks (timeline):
- Initial push (Feb 14): CI failed - flaky integration test.
- Fix push (Feb 17): CI passed unit tests, integration flaky on slow runners. Investigated and converted timing asserts to metric-wait hooks.
- Final push (Feb 18): CI green (all checks pass: unit, integration, lint, packaging).

Testing and validation performed: 
- Unit tests added covering scoring heuristics and preset parsing (tests/).
- Integration smoke run against local minicluster using synthetic traffic profiles (low, medium, burst) validating that signalizer.prefill_score correlates with expected prefill benefits.
- Eval gating validated by running prompt-sets in harness and asserting L0/L1 metric thresholds are preserved (no more than 2% BLEU-like metric drop for conversational prompts).

Operational impact / Monitoring: 
- New metrics listed in docs and dashboard. Ops runbook added describing how to inspect signalizer decisions and how to revert tenant defaults.
- Alerting recommendations: add alert for signalizer.evaluation_failures > 3 in 1h and prefill_advisor.suggested_quant_level spikes to detect noisy signals.

Security & privacy: 
- Signalizer only consumes aggregated sampling and does not persist raw user payloads; design doc clarifies retention and PI mitigation. Prefill-advisor CLI runs locally and only submits manifests when operator explicitly applies them.

Follow-ups planned (tracked as Linear):
- ENG-1305: Auto-apply flow with staged canary + rollback automation (opt-in, gated by SLA)
- ENG-1318: Expand quant presets for multimodal models and provide per-model fallback heuristics
- ENG-1329: Tenant-facing UI in Console to preview and accept recommendations

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps automatic apply disabled. The current focus is to provide high-confidence, auditable suggestions owners can review. The eval harness and safe_fallbacks are designed to reduce false positives and protect model quality.
